summary: Computes an orientation-scaled attenuation factor as a dot-product ratio: the dot of a caller-supplied direction vector a2 with the orientation sub-struct reached through this+0x54 (offsets 0x7C, 0x80, 0x84), plus 330.0, divided by the dot of a2 with the listener-direction components at this+0x34, this+0x38, this+0x3C, plus 330.0, then multiplied by the current gain at this+0x48. The result is clamped to [0.125, 8.0] and written back to this+0x48. Called from F_3DSoundPositioningUpdate (0x00405B90) in the 3D audio positioning path.

Compute the denominator as the dot of a2 with the listener-direction components at this+0x34, this+0x38, this+0x3C plus 330.0.
Form the scaled factor v2 = (numerator / denominator) * current gain at this+0x48.
Clamp v2 to [0.125, 8.0]: if v2 is below 0.125f write 1040187392 (0.125f) to this+0x48; else if v2 is above 8.0f write 1090519040 (8.0f) to this+0x48; otherwise store v2 unchanged.
